## Functions

### `createRealmRuntimeHostLifecycleChannel(source)`

Capture the exact frozen realmRuntimeHostLifecycle@1 source for a v3 lease. Source callbacks are synchronous enqueue/accept operations returning exactly frozen { accepted: true }. They must not await participant delivery, Entry shutdown, lease close or registry destruction. Such waits would turn an acknowledgement into cleanup authority and create self-drain cycles. Returns exactly frozen { channel, retire }. Only the host-only channel goes to Desktop; the controller remains in the registry. Each channel method returns an owned Promise, invokes its pinned source callback in a later microtask, and validates its synchronous acknowledgement. At most 64 owned notifications may be pending; excess dispatch fails before enqueue. No thenable or returned Promise is assimilated; standard accidental rejections are consumed. Unknown fields, raw reasons, and native source exceptions never escape. retire() synchronously fences new/queued dispatch, awaits already owned invocation settlement and returns one stable frozen { retired: true }. It never calls the provider's close method. The registry does that afterward and keeps the channel fenced if provider cleanup requires a retry. No lifecycle identities, subscriptions, stop completion, GPU-loss proof, participant delivery or full runtime provider are manufactured here.

## Notes & Examples

### Command Bus Pattern

The OS uses a capability-gated command bus for inter-app and system communication. Apps register command handlers; the kernel routes commands based on capabilities. Commands can be local (same app), cross-app (with permission), or system-level (elevated).

**Example: Command registration and invocation**
```js
import { CommandBus } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/CommandBus.js';
import { Capability } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/Capability.js';

const bus = new CommandBus();

// Register a handler (requires 'ui' capability)
bus.register('myapp:openFile', async (path) => {
  const content = await storage.read(path);
  return { content, size: content.length };
}, { capability: 'storage' });

// Invoke locally
const result = await bus.invoke('myapp:openFile', '/docs/readme.md');

// Cross-app invocation (requires 'interop' capability)
const otherApp = bus.proxy('otherapp');
const data = await otherApp.invoke('otherapp:compute', input);

// Broadcast to all listening apps
bus.broadcast('system:themeChanged', { theme: 'dark' });
```

**See also:** [WebGPU OS Architecture](/webgpu-os/architecture.md) · [Security Model](/concepts/security-model.md)
